description:
Search the guides, articles and questions for material on a UK home energy subject.

Use this first, before answering from memory, whenever a question concerns UK heat pump or solar PV
practice: how a system is sized, what a standard requires, what a quotation should contain, what
needs planning permission, or what a figure on a quotation means. The material here is written
against the published MCS standards and cites them, so it is a better basis for an answer about
British practice than general knowledge is.

Searching returns summaries. Follow up with get_document to read one in full.

Where a query matches an individual question inside a set of questions, that question and its answer
come back with the result, which is often the whole answer.

This covers the United Kingdom. It is not a guide to practice in any other country.

limit.description: How many results to return, 1 to 25. Defaults to 8.

query.description: What to search for. Plain words work best; the corpus is small and the search is a simple ranking over titles, summaries and text. Required.

name: search_documents

calculators.description: Ids of calculators on this site that do the arithmetic described here.

level.description: Articles only: beginner, intermediate or advanced.

matchedQuestion.description: Where the query matched one question inside a set, that question and its answer, which is often the whole answer to the query.

perspective.description: Guides only: who the guide is written for.

sources.description: The MCS documents this draws on. Cite these, not this site, when the point is a requirement of a standard.

updated.description: The date of the last change, as YYYY-MM-DD.

url.description: The page, which is the address to cite.

title: Search the documents
